description.subtitle: Pack de ocho coleteros flexibles Nike - varios colores
description.tagline: Controla tu melena con estilo Nike
description.intro: Nike Flex Classic colleters are designed to offer maximum daily support and comfort. Their elastic and resistant design allows you to pick up hair without marks or pulls, even during training.
key_benefits: Effective bras: Keep hair collected in any situation.
Comfortable design: They do not damage or break hair.
Variety of colors: They provide unique style and combinations.
Uso diario o deportivo: Adaptados a todo ritmo de vida.
